We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, maybe we need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons. Could also retrieve carbon shifts ranges but not specific. We need the actual compound structure. Not provided. Maybe the system expects us to call carbon_nmr_spectra to get spectrum, then count aromatic carbon signals? But we need the compound identity. Could be that the environment has a sample loaded; we can get carbon NMR which will list chemical shifts; aromatic carbons appear around 110-160 ppm. We could count number of peaks in that region.

Thus we should call carbon_nmr_spectra.
